changelog: Fixed TikTok photo downloads from QuickSave getting stuck
Fixed multiple photo downloads generating separate notifications by combining them into a single unified progress notification
Fixed QuickSave downloads not appearing in the main app's Floating Download Balloon
Fixed QuickSave opening or bringing the main application window to the foreground when the app is already present in Recent Apps
Fixed text and background contrast blending on .LRC export and outline buttons in Dark Mode
Fixed various download and notification issues related to server switching
Added Snooze options to the OTA Update notification with 1 Day, 3 Days, and 1 Week options
Improved the Update Available window with a Remind Me Later feature
Updated Spotify scraper servers with Spotisaver as primary server & fallback handling
Added SSSTik as an additional TikTok server with support for no-watermark videos, MP3 audio, and photo slides
Improved Twitter/X download performance by prioritizing the direct FxTwitter server
Added multi-language support (EN, ID, ZH, JA) to MixTools, Edit Lyrics, and Reset Lyrics windows
